takeaway: Congenital diaphragmatic hernia most commonly occurs through the posterolateral Bochdalek foramen.

lines.text: A baby girl is born with severe respiratory distress.
It is caused by a congenital diaphragmatic hernia, which was diagnosed antenatally.
The diaphragm has several openings. Which one did the hernia pass through?
Congenital diaphragmatic hernia most commonly occurs through the posterolateral foramen of Bochdalek.
lines.say: Congenital diaphragmatic hernia most commonly occurs through the posterolateral foramen of Bok-dah-lek.

lines.text: So for a newborn with a congenital diaphragmatic hernia, think of Bochdalek's foramen.
